answer:
The flag is `--repeat`. The eval command runs each test multiple times with it. The guide says: "The `eval` command has a parameter, `repeat`, which runs each test multiple times:" [promptfoo/site/docs/guides/evaluate-llm-temperature.md]

The same guide gives the example: "The above command runs the LLM three times for each test case, helping you get a more complete sample of how it performs at a given temperature." [promptfoo/site/docs/guides/evaluate-llm-temperature.md]

The command is `promptfoo eval --repeat 3`. The docs also mention that `--filter-range` is applied before `--repeat` expansion, so the two can be combined. [promptfoo/site/docs/usage/command-line.md]
